name: print-social-purple-glass-frame-event-decor-poster-with-flowers
title: Unforgettable Event Decor Poster with Glass Frame
whatItIs: A portrait event-decor poster over a purple-lit banquet hall photo with gold chairs and a floral centrepiece, framed by a thin glass-outlined panel with a light serif headline 'Unforgettable is what we do!', a tagline chip and a location chip.
whatItMeans: A frosted frame around the hero flowers focuses the eye, and the elegant serif and purple light feel celebratory.
techniques: Thin translucent outline frame around the focal area
Rounded white text chips for the tagline and contact
Focal flowers positioned in the frame centre

vocabulary.definition: A thin translucent border used to frame part of an image.
A small rounded box holding a line of details.
A photo lit or graded in one colour.
